title: Cognitive effects

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Cognitive effects are defined as any subjective effect which directly alters one's cognition or introduces new content to an aspect of it. 
This page lists and describes the various cognitive effects which can occur under the influence of certain psychoactive compounds. It also further organizes these effects into subcategories based on their features and behavior.

Cognitive enhancements

Cognitive depressions

Cognitive intensifications

Cognitive suppressions

Novel cognitive states

Psychological effects

Transpersonal effects
